query: Consider the following context: During the hot dip aluminum plating process, components such as sinking rollers, pulling rollers, and guide plates will come into long-term contact with high-temperature liquid aluminum and be corroded by the aluminum liquid, greatly reducing their service life. In that context, which material can be used for prepare parts for the dipping and plating equipment and protect the equipment from erosion, and why?

generation.hypothesis: Applying a ceramic coating, specifically alumina (Al2O3), to the surface of the equipment components via plasma spraying will enhance their resistance to corrosion by high-temperature liquid aluminum, thereby increasing their service life.
generation.material_initial_state: Base metal (e.g., steel) for the equipment components
generation.intervention: Plasma spraying of an alumina (Al2O3) ceramic coating
generation.conditions: High-temperature environment of the hot dip aluminum plating process, with temperatures up to 700°C
generation.mechanism: The ceramic coating acts as a barrier, preventing direct contact between the liquid aluminum and the base metal, thus reducing corrosion
generation.predicted_outcome: A 50% increase in service life of the equipment components compared to uncoated components, measured in hours of operation
generation.boundary: Temperature range of 600°C to 800°C, and exposure to liquid aluminum for up to 1000 hours
generation.uncertainty: The actual increase in service life may vary depending on the specific process conditions, coating thickness, and adhesion of the ceramic coating to the base metal

falsification_experiment.design: Comparative study of coated and uncoated equipment components in the hot dip aluminum plating process
measurements: Service life of components in hours
falsification_experiment.falsification_rule: If the coated components do not show at least a 30% increase in service life compared to uncoated components after 500 hours of operation, the hypothesis is falsified

frame.system: Hot dip aluminum plating equipment, specifically components like sinking rollers, pulling rollers, and guide plates, in contact with high-temperature liquid aluminum
frame.goal: To identify a material for preparing parts for the dipping and plating equipment that can protect it from erosion by liquid aluminum
frame.limitation: Corrosion of equipment components by high-temperature liquid aluminum, reducing their service life
root_cause_cues: long-term contact with high-temperature liquid aluminum
constraints: resistance to corrosion by liquid aluminum
frame.regime: High-temperature environment of the hot dip aluminum plating process
prior_attempts: Current materials used for equipment components, which are not specified but implied to be inadequate due to the corrosion issue
